_note: Operator-owned definitions for `manage.py register_products`. Data only: no plan, no price, no credential and no trial is defined here (those are commercial decisions made in the Super Admin console). Descriptions and features are DRAFT copy to be confirmed by each product's owner and editable in the product manager. Each redirect URI is a PLACEHOLDER: a product must implement OIDC authorization code + PKCE and its owner must replace it (PUT the manifest) before single sign-on can work. Until an unrevoked credential exists the console reports 'SSO integration required'.
